title: search input attributes
rule: Search input attributes — `autocomplete` on search can leak sensitive queries on shared machines. `autocorrect` / `spellcheck` conflict with server-side search correction. Do not rely on `required` as the only “empty search” message.
pass_when: Search does not use `autocomplete` in a way that stores sensitive queries; `autocorrect`/`spellcheck` are not fighting server-side correction; empty search is not messaged by `required` alone.
fail_when: Search `autocomplete` stores queries on a shared machine; `required` is the only empty-search message.
overview: Avoid search autocomplete that stores sensitive queries; do not rely on required alone for empty search.
apply_when: Configuring HTML attributes on site or app search inputs.
not_when: Non-search text fields that need ordinary autocomplete.
agent_hint: Skip sensitive autocomplete on search; do not message empty search with required alone.
description: Search `autocomplete` can leak sensitive queries on shared machines; `autocorrect` / `spellcheck` conflict with server-side search correction; do not rely on `required` as the only empty-search message. Pass when search does not store sensitive queries via autocomplete, autocorrect/spellcheck are not fighting server-side correction, and empty search is not messaged by `required` alone; fail when search autocomplete stores queries on a shared machine or `required` is the only empty-search message.
do_not_claim: Header-search placeholder exception; Suomi visually-hidden search label as this attributes row.
